microarray.readouts: genome-wide gene expression levels; differentially expressed genes

evidence.quote: Total RNA from PBMCs (~1.5 × 10 6 cells) was purified using Trizol (Invitrogen, Life Technologies Corporation) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Samples were checked for purity and hybridized on Human U133 Plus 2.0 Arrays (Affymetrix).

flow cytometry.readouts: NK cell and monocyte subset frequencies; CD69, CCR5 and CD86 expression

evidence.quote: 2–3 × 10 6 PBMCs were thawed and stained with live/dead marker (Alexa Fluor 430, Life Technologies) to exclude dead cells. Cells were then stained with an appropriate antibody cocktail. Cells were washed, fixed, and analyzed on the LSRII flow cytometer (BD).

hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibo.readouts: strain-specific HAI antibody titers; fold change of titer at day 28 and day 180 relative to baseline

evidence.quote: We evaluated the plasma antibody responses of all vaccinated individuals via hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibody titer assays.

miRNA expression profiling.readouts: expression levels of 672 human miRNAs; differentially expressed miRNAs after vaccination

evidence.quote: we measured the miRNA expression profiles of 672 human miRNAs on days 1, 3, and 7 after vaccination from a subset of subjects in the 2010 cohort
